summary: Reproduce unexpected behavior, find duplicates, and prepare or file a privacy-safe issue at a calibrated priority.

useCases.title: Report a bug
useCases.message: Research this product problem, check the relevant team and code context, search our actual ticketing system for duplicates, and prepare or file a grounded issue within the current permission.

useCases.title: Report a customer bug
useCases.message: Research and reproduce this customer-reported product problem, check team and code context, find duplicate issues, and prepare or file a grounded issue while keeping sensitive customer data out of broad engineering records.
